Returns a dated preliminary or live verdict for each state, the source registry portal, and the full results URL. This is not a name reservation; the state confirms at filing. tools.name: check_trademark_conflicts
tools.description: Could this business name conflict with a federal trademark? Returns matching marks, status, classes, owner, record links, the register date, and the full results URL. Optional filters can narrow or rank the search. This is a conflict screen, not legal advice and not trademark clearance. Use check_bu

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Is this domain available or taken? Check a name across up to five TLDs using a registered-zone index, live DNS, and the registry's RDAP record. Each row names its status and source, and the answer includes the full results URL. Use check_business_name instead for a complete name check.

tools.name: check_social_handles
tools.description: Are these social handles available or taken? tools.name: get_state_naming_rules
tools.description: What are this state's LLC naming rules? Returns the required designator, restricted-word note, recorded statute citation, state registry search portal, and results site URL. No name availability check is performed.

tools.name: get_trademark
tools.description: What does this federal trademark serial number identify? Returns the mark, status, owner, dates, classes, goods and services, first use, publication, pseudo mark, register date, and the TSDR record link.
